title: Golf Advisory Committee Meeting Summary - June 30, 2026 — Jun 30, 6:05 PM
summary: Residents must sign in every time they play golf, and the committee will develop violations and penalties. Next meeting is September 8, 2026.
public_detail: residents' responsibility for non-paying guests. Motion was made to develop violations and penalties. To address issues initially and for further problems to be escalated through a process starting with the Golf Advisory Committee, Rules & Regulations, and Resource Management. Motion was made that Players must sign in the book EVERY time a round is played. Article in the July LINK "A Healthier You - Through Golf at Palm Hill". Anyone interested in writing a golf related article for the LIN please contact Caroline Zimmerman. Megan stated that residents should reach out to their insurance regarding reimbursement to use the medical/wellness card to pay for their golf membership fee. Next meeting September 8, 2026. That concludes my concise report for this month.
